research_sources.title: JLR NP10-V8JLR 04/2009 technical training
research_sources.limit: Training architecture and labelled components, not 2012 measured casting geometry or current service procedures.

research_sources.title: SSM51477 — 5.0 Oil Rear of Engine PDI
research_sources.reviewed: One page; last modified 11-Jan-2013. L320 listed.
research_sources.limit: Documents an upper rear threaded block-plug source and lower bellhousing accumulation pattern, referencing SSM49817. It also discusses anti-corrosion oil at PDI. Neither is an automatic diagnosis for this in-service vehicle. No exact model-space coordinates are supplied.

research_sources.title: SSM49817 reproduced text and illustration
research_sources.reviewed: Text and figure G00376236 inspected; figure identifies LR008871.
research_sources.limit: Original factory-hosted attachment not retrieved. Reproduction is not treated as independent proof of measured 3D centre, bank side, or any rear head ball-plug function. Primary SSM51477 independently references the block-plug concern.

research_sources.title: L320 NA block and plugs — P0190547-07
research_sources.reviewed: Drawing and callouts, including HP1–HP4 and 6K301A/B, reviewed.
research_sources.limit: Catalogue callouts alone do not establish all fluid connections. Rear carrier revisions depend on engine serial; exact vehicle revision is not selected.

research_sources.title: L320 NA cylinder head — P0190560-04
research_sources.reviewed: Head outline, exterior relationships and gasket 6051.
research_sources.limit: No confirmed rear ball-plug map. No measured rear casting profiles or under-manifold oil-closure locations recovered.

research_sources.title: L320 NA exhaust manifolds — P0190562-03
research_sources.reviewed: Separate LH/RH manifolds, mounting relationship, gaskets and shields.
research_sources.limit: Profiles reconstructed approximately; thickness, stand-offs, fastener centres and installed clearances unmeasured. No particular casting/manufacturing method is claimed.

research_sources.title: Jaguar factory V8 macro photographs
research_sources.reviewed: Block/valley material and broad casting appearance.
research_sources.limit: Not a complete 2012 L320 NA reference set. Supercharger images are not imported as evidence of NA component interchangeability.

The manufacturer NHTSA-hosted SSM51477 was used for the rear block source-to-seam statement.
No factory rear-head ball-plug map or confirmed additional under-manifold oil-closure map was recovered.
Factory identity/layout evidence does not verify reconstructed dimensions or diagnostic conclusions.
